## scripts/kind-fleet.sh
[fleet]
name = "api"

[cluster.kind]
context = "x"
namespace = "gdl-api"
region = "local"
registry = "x/gdl"
platform = "linux/x"

[cluster.kind.node_selector]
"gdl.dev/node-group" = "gdl-api"

[[cluster.kind.tolerations]]
key = "dedicated"
operator = "Equal"
value = "gdl-api"
effect = "NoSchedule"

[cluster.kind.resources.default.requests]
cpu = "50m"
memory = "64Mi"

[cluster.kind.resources.default.limits]
cpu = "1"
memory = "512Mi"

[class.global.ready]
front = 1

[class.model.ready]
engine = 1

[pool.global]
class = "global"
cluster = "kind"

[pool.model-a]
class = "model"
cluster = "kind"
home = "global"

[pool.model-a.resources.segment.engine.limits]
memory = "768Mi"

[pool.model-b]
class = "model"
cluster = "kind"
home = "global"

{"fleet":{"name":"api"},"cluster":{"kind":{"context":"x","namespace":"gdl-api","region":"local","registry":"x/gdl","platform":"linux/x","node_selector":{"gdl.dev/node-group":"gdl-api"},"tolerations":[{"key":"dedicated","operator":"Equal","value":"gdl-api","effect":"NoSchedule"}],"resources":{"default":{"requests":{"cpu":"50m","memory":"64Mi"},"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"512Mi"}}}}},"class":{"global":{"ready":{"front":1}},"model":{"ready":{"engine":1}}},"pool":{"global":{"class":"global","cluster":"kind"},"model-a":{"class":"model","cluster":"kind","home":"global","resources":{"segment":{"engine":{"limits":{"memory":"768Mi"}}}}},"model-b":{"class":"model","cluster":"kind","home":"global"}}}

## tests/fleet/clusters.rs CLUSTERED
[fleet]
name = "llm-proof"

[cluster.euw1]
context = "kind-euw1"
namespace = "gdl-llm"
region = "eu-west-1"

[cluster.use1]
context = "kind-use1"
namespace = "gdl-llm"
region = "us-east-1"
registry = "registry.example/gdl"
platform = "linux/amd64"
pins_local = true
operator = true

[cluster.use1.service_account_annotations]
"eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = "arn:aws:iam::0:role/gdl"

[cluster.use1.secrets]
sequence-key = "llm-sequence-key"

[cluster.use1.env]
SET_RECORDS_TABLE = "llm-pins-use1"

[cluster.usw2]
context = "kind-usw2"
namespace = "gdl-llm"
region = "us-west-2"

[class.global.ready]
a = 2
b = 2
c = 2

[class.global.requires]
model_x = 1

[class.model_x.ready]
d = 1
e = 4
f = 2

[pool.global-eu-west-1]
class = "global"
cluster = "euw1"

[pool.global-us-east-1]
class = "global"
cluster = "use1"

[pool.global-us-west-2]
class = "global"
cluster = "usw2"

[pool.model-x-01-eu-west-1]
class = "model_x"
cluster = "euw1"
home = "global-eu-west-1"

[pool.model-x-01-us-east-1]
class = "model_x"
cluster = "use1"
region = "us-east-1"
home = "global-us-east-1"

[pool.model-x-01-us-west-2]
class = "model_x"
cluster = "usw2"
home = "global-us-west-2"

[pool.model-x-02-us-east-1]
class = "model_x"
cluster = "use1"
home = "global-us-east-1"
